description: The chart illustrates averaged Shapley values for tokens at different relative positions to a probed target word, shown separately for three models (mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM). The horizontal axis contains the positional categories, ordered left-to-right as L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺ (left context positions, the target T, and right context positions). The vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80 (values extend slightly below 0 for some bars). For each category, three side-by-side bars are shown: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in darker blue, and chLSTM in light green. Approximate bar heights are: at L₄⁺, mBERT and XLM-R are both around 5 while chLSTM is near 0; at L₃, mBERT is near 0–1, XLM-R around 2, and chLSTM near 0; at L₂, mBERT is about 4, XLM-R about 5, and chLSTM about 1; at L₁, all three are around 13–15; at T, mBERT is about 59, XLM-R about 55, and chLSTM about 79–80 (the tallest bars in the figure); at R₁, mBERT is around 10, XLM-R around 11, and chLSTM around 9; at R₂, mBERT is around 2, XLM-R around 2–3, and chLSTM slightly below 0 (around −2); at R₃, mBERT is near 0, XLM-R slightly above 0, and chLSTM slightly below 0 (around −1 to −2); and at R₄⁺, mBERT is around 4–5, XLM-R around 5, and chLSTM slightly below 0 (around −1). The bars are not sorted by magnitude; they follow the positional order, and there are no special visual emphases beyond the color legend in the upper-right.
